other_addresses_note: All five carry the same contract bytes as the deployment of record. The three diagnostic addresses are disposable deployments used to see what real validators do with the panel-decided cases before a canonical deployment; deploy/diagnostics/ holds their runs. The two superseded canonical addresses were abandoned for reasons in the live run, never in the contract: on the first, the run's own agreement terms set a 60-second appeal window - shorter than the two transactions an appeal takes on StudioNet - so the contract refused the appeal exactly as written, and that agreement was then closed through the documented stalled route (UNSETTLED_ADJUDICATION, the buyer refunded in full and withdrawn, so it holds no escrow). On the second, an interrupted attempt had already consumed the agreement id AG-000001, and the fixture evidence is bound to that id by its own contents, so the arc was restarted from a clean deployment.
